title: Extensa campaign file (swdb.extensa-campaign.v1)
description: Created 2026-10-03 ET (ticket 52, decision D5). An input file under campaigns/extensa/, not a record; checked by swdb validate and swdb campaign. Updated 2026-10-05 ET: the ID pattern is the envelope's $defs.extensa_campaign_id, added when swdb.campaign loads this schema. Updated 2026-10-09 ET: paired_estimates.numeric_pairing_check (D35). Updated 2026-10-14 ET (Probata PoC fix-21): optional method_version pin.

isolation.description: Native blocks start only while the other socket's lease and the legacy lease are released; recorded per block (ticket 56 isolation test, 2026-10-04 ET; legacy lease since 2026-10-05 ET).

evaluator.description: Native evaluator version the Extensa campaign's protocols pin (ticket 63, 2026-10-04 ET; v3 ticket 67); absent means v1.

speed_rule.description: Native speed-rule version (ticket 66, 2026-10-04 ET, decided by Yan-Ru; v2 ticket 72: the A/A pilot gates on base_source only); absent means swdb.speed_rule.range.v1.

new_enabling_contracts.description: Probata PoC 63: the rewriting role may write a new experimental enabling contract beside its patch (its answer then carries `new_contract`); the loop adds it to the campaign's library only when allowed_tiers include experimental.

provider_calls_proof.description: Probata PoC 16 (2026-10-14 ET): the WP phase's proof-hint calls, apart from the rewriting total; above the spec default 30 only with an approval entry naming it. Required when the campaign's library holds a method version.

numeric_pairing_check.description: Added 2026-10-09 ET (D35): the paired_estimate record ID of a passing numeric pairing check in the team store. swdb campaign refuses a new campaign on a real target without it; under the current paired_estimate schema no record can pass yet.

paired_estimates.description: Default enabled; explicit legacy opt-out never produces eligible paired evidence.

method_version.description: Probata PoC fix-21 (2026-10-14 ET): the method version (library/methods/, draft or frozen) the campaign's bounded gate and WP phase run under. Without it the campaign uses the current frozen method version, and a library holding only drafts keeps the gate off. A pin with no file is refused.

derived_starts.description: Probata PoC 19 (2026-10-14 ET): the certified derived implementations of this kernel an iteration may start from (the rewrite role names its `start`: one of these, or null for the base source). An ID may name a derived implementation this campaign records in an earlier iteration.

gem5_other_socket.description: Native blocks may run while another Extensa campaign's gem5 job holds the other socket; recorded per block (ticket 64, 2026-10-04 ET).
